requirements.text: A task node that includes the string attributes identifier, category, and task type. This node also has integer attributes to describe the importance, complexity level and centrality of the task.
An operator in some expression language.
A node describing a task that may be decomposed on other sub-tasks.
A task with an associated expression
A task with an associate operator
A binary operator with only one operand which is a Task
A unary operator which acts over some task
